title: PUFFIN ROCK
about: Puffin Rock as a side-scroller in cut-paper layers: you are Oona, Baba waddles after you. West to east: the seabird cliffs (walk to the edge and the wind lifts you up among the gannets; kittiwakes on the ledges), the pond (lily pads that bounce you across, a frog who shows you), through a tunnel in the great old tree into the Mossy Wood (five glowing mushrooms to light and count), the burrow with Mama and Papa — and under it the tunnels (js/under.js): the nest chamber for a nap, a sleeping hedgehog who curls into a ball, a worm, and a long chute that slides you down and pops you out of May's warren, where her family pop up to say hello — the meadow of dandelion clocks where May the rabbit lives, the rocks and Mossy's eggshell slide, the beach and the sea (float, dive, catch fish in your beak and feed Baba), Silky the seal's rock (ride on her back under the sea and out in a leap), the rocky shore (rock pools with a crab and an anemone, and a blowhole that whooshes you into the sky), the sand dunes (dig up sea glass, a scallop and a mermaid's purse) and the bog, where a waterfall tumbles into a pool and a shower under it makes a rainbow. Under the burrow, tunnels branch up to a wood mouse's larder (peekaboo) and down to a cave where light races along the fungi's threads. Walk by tapping or the arrow keys; tap the sky or press up to flap. Narrated by an Irish voice with true facts; recordings in voice/ (tools/narrate.mjs). Uses the shared vendor/three mount.
